target_customer: Spanish-speaking individuals paying monthly for therapy, and employers buying mental health benefits (Terapify 360, including NOM-035 support)
problem: Spanish-speaking people have limited access to affordable, culturally matched mental healthcare. Terapify connects them with vetted psychotherapists by video.
business_model: Direct to consumer recurring therapy sessions plus B2B employee benefit subscriptions
product_category: online therapy and digital mental health

founders.name: Juan Daniel Velez Santiago
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no bio; CB Insights lists him as CEO.

founders.name: Eduardo Velez Santiago
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no bio; Seedtable says he founded the company in 2018.

competitors.name: Tu Consejeria
competitors.what: Online therapy and psychological counseling for businesses, schools and organizations

technical_complexity.rationale: A video chat and matching platform on standard web tooling; the difficulty is therapist supply and trust, not engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Ongoing therapist relationships create some stickiness, but telehealth platforms are easy to replicate and several Spanish language rivals existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying by an incumbent was found.

market_need_then: Terapify's own materials say it serves people in more than 45 countries each month; a Mexican business outlet covers mental health access gaps and the NOM-035 workplace rule drives employer demand.

branding.community_and_virality: Launched on Product Hunt on March 17, 2021.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is easily confused with Therapify (Poland) and Terapi; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Terapify serves the Spanish-speaking market with consumer therapy and an employer product, took a small seed around November 2020 backed by Carabela and others, and was still active with a team of 15 per the YC page. Funding after the seed is not public so growth and outcome remain unclear.
notes: Company website was not fetched separately. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. Seed amount is unknown: PitchBook shows $250K, El Español reportedly over $1M, CB Insights total $190K; none verified so amount_usd is null. PitchBook lists Mar 2023 and Caplight Dec 2023 rounds without amounts, unverified. The Polish Therapify is a different company. Competitors come from undated comparison pages. Founded year conflicts (2018 vs 2019). Founder backgrounds not found.
